title: Iteration 1: Hero & Floor
goal: Bug! The hero falls through the world. Fix the floor.
mascot_lines: Step one of building any game — get the hero to show up on the screen.
Step two — add a floor so the hero stops falling forever.
It's gonna look basic at first, and that's exactly right.
We always start with the simplest version, then add cool stuff one piece at a time.

tier2.rephrase: The bug is about the floor. Pick the fix that adds floor collision.

tier3.nudge: The hero needs to STOP when it touches the floor. Look for 'stop on floor'.

sandbox.hint: Ask: 'why does my hero fall forever?'
